reason: I'm paying about 12 a square metre now with film and tape and our own lads, and this is 19 plus a 150 m2 minimum. The aluminium already comes with factory film, so I'd be paying more for something I mostly already have.
objection: It costs over 50% more than film and tape, needs a 50% deposit up front, and I don't see what it fixes that the factory film doesn't. On our small jobs 150 m2 is more than I'd need.
instead: Keep the factory film on the aluminium and use our own film, sheet and tape on the rest, applied by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A total price at or below 12 a square metre, with no minimum and no deposit, and proof it saves me real snagging cost on a job like mine.
